answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a Sybil-resistant mechanism known as Proof of Physical Work (PoPW). This involves requiring agents to prove they control a unique physical device, such as a quartz sensor, tied to a specific geographic location, like a ridge or a willow tree. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities will incur significant costs, as they must deploy and maintain numerous physical devices, making it economically infeasible to launch a large-scale Sybil attack.
